name: Should I repair or replace a rotted fence post?

mainEntity.name: Should I repair or replace a rotted fence post?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding whether to repair or replace a rotted fence post depends on the severity and location of the rot. If the rot is confined to the base and the rest of the post is sound, repair using a post-saver or concrete reinforcement might be sufficient. However, if the rot extends significantly up the post or affects multiple sides, replacement is often a more durable long-term solution. A practical tradeoff is balancing the immediate cost savings of repair against the longevity and stability offered by a full replacement. An assessment by Frasheski Construction can help determine the best approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair minor rot at the base; replace if rot is extensive. Balance immediate cost savings of repair against the long-term stability of replacement.
